Run CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy on redis-cache
If the policy changed recently, restore allkeys-lru via config-service
Warm hot keys with the cache-warmer job
Watch redis-cache p99 latency for 15 minutes
Record the change id in the incident timeline

4. Warm hot keys with the cache-warmer job
5. Watch redis-cache p99 latency for 15 minutes
6. Record the change id in the incident timeline

Post an update in the incident channel
